summary: No project is broken and no hard rule is breached. The one break of the week, the frozen dashboard feed, ended when the usage collector ran again; usage.json read 23:54 UTC at 18:33 local, and every live version matches its status file. Open per-project actions fall from three to zero, with 17 queue rows completed since the last pass. The weak spot is the shared tooling the four projects run through: the eleven portfolio lenses average 76, held down by stale public version pills, duplicate skill triggers and a skill snapshot that has differed from source for 88 days.

topActions.label: Upload the current personal-skills plugin so the desktop snapshot matches source; it has differed for 88 days.
Bring every public version pill up to its status file and add an audit row that fails on a mismatch.
Remove the merged Gnosis worktrees and stop ingest sessions leaving one behind.
Merge or fence the duplicate voice skills.
Add Gnosis to the truncation tail check and read each project's declared critical files.
Put the monthly and quarterly Windows tasks on their documented calendars.
Clear the two red lines that persist in the routine health report: the second account's server not running, and the temp cleanup action failing behind a green exit code.
Give the ten source-less skills a source copy under version control.
Rewrite the Apothecary source comments that name the review process.
Bring the git-unstick skill in line with the plain-mount hazard register.
